cases.name: Jacqueline Castano
cases.about: She was a special ed teacher at Madison Creek Elementary School in Goodlettsville. They had been married 3 years. Just minutes after allegedly killing his wife - and before police arrived to arrest him -  Castano posted a status update on his Facebook page hinting that his wife may have been unfaithful to him.
